title: Eric's Terrible Additions
description: a mod that adds the most random things, including a new ore, a liquid, with more yet to come!
body:
A mod that adds the most random things you can think of, made by a fellow person on the internet.

Currently adds:
- MULTIPLE ores (Chrysoberyl, Tin, Antimony to name a few)
- 1 new biome (Ourple Biome)
- 2 new foodstuff (Blackcurrant and Pufferfish Nuggets)
- 1 new liquid (Blackcurrant Juice)
- 1 new mob (Grig)
- 2 new ranged weapons (Pufferfish McNuggets and The Burgerer)
All neatly organized in creative tabs.
There is more to come for ETA, too.

# what does this mod add??
It currently adds 1 new mineral (Chrysoberyl), which is an in-between between diamond and netherite, 1 new food (Blackcurrant), alongside it's respective liquid; Blackcurrant Juice. 1 new mob is added, which spawns in the  Ourple Biome, being the Grig. It is passive, but if you kill it, it drops souls of sillyness, that you can use to craft the two ranged weapons this mod adds; The Burgerer and the Pufferfish McNuggets; speaking of which, you can now craft pufferfish nuggets via cooking pufferfish.
Pretty cool, don't you think?

You can also go explore 6 new biomes. In the Overworld you can go to the suevite peaks and the frozen ashes, in Glagworld you can go to glaggleland, frowntown and gleeberland, while in Venus you can go to the Venusian Volcano.

This also adds three new bosses, the robotic Soirsn, the hellish Infernal Congealment and the otherworldly Venus Slime (trust me, you need fire resistance potions for it's fight!)

# what features does this mod add??
This mod currently only adds:
1. Ranged weapons
2. Biomes
3. Structures
4. 3 new dimensions
5. 3 new bosses.

#NOTE
 The recipe for Pewter ingots in the alloy smelter is with 1 copper ingot and 1 tin ingot
